also.anchor: start: datetime   # in the account's local time zone

bugs.summary: Session start/end are local times sharing one ZoneInfo object, and Python subtracts aware datetimes with the same tzinfo by wall clock, ignoring the UTC offset. Sessions that cross a DST change are billed for the wrong duration (one hour too few in autumn, one too many in spring); the duration must be computed in UTC.
bugs.trigger: a-100 (New York) session 2026-11-01 04:30Z-07:30Z is 3 real hours but bills 2; session 2026-03-08 06:30Z-07:20Z is 50 minutes but bills 2.

related_valid: A stop event without a matching start, or a start that never stops, is silently dropped (unbilled); pre-existing in sessions.py.
A session with end == start (or clock skew giving end < start) is billed one hour by max(1, ...) without any check.
